about: Focused scheduler regression mutants, run with their named killers. Model searches reserve all scheduler slots for memory isolation.

mutants.name: b15-r8-run-memory-reservation-disconnected
mutants.rule: The running gate connects MemoryHeavy to an exclusive slot reservation.

mutants.name: b15-r7-model-memory-unreserved
mutants.rule: Every model search declares a full-gate memory reservation.

mutants.name: b15-r7-memory-slot-undercharged
mutants.rule: A queued memory-heavy step reserves all requested slots, not one.

mutants.name: b15-r7-memory-immediate-undercharged
mutants.rule: An immediate memory-heavy reservation also takes all requested slots.

mutants.name: gf3-shards-dealt-by-wall
mutants.rule: A package with recorded CPU rows deals its shards by CPU, not wall time.

mutants.name: gf3-hang-floor-at-go-default
mutants.rule: No go test step's deadline is go test's 15 minute default.

mutants.name: gf3-build-step-without-deadline
mutants.rule: Every go test command of a step passes -timeout.

mutants.name: gf3-shard-deadline-ignores-cost
mutants.rule: A shard's deadline is ten times its recorded cost.

mutants.name: gf3-pause-keeps-the-span
mutants.rule: A paused test's wait is not its CPU.
